title: Create a C++ Actor
description: Write a simple Actor class with a mesh component and BeginPlay log.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Create your first C++ Actor class with a Static Mesh component and debug log.

1. In Unreal Editor, create a new C++ class inheriting from **Actor**. Name it `MyFirstActor`.
2. Open the header file. Add a UPROPERTY for a Static Mesh Component:
   ```cpp
   UPROPERTY(VisibleAnywhere)
   UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComp;
   ```
3. In the .cpp constructor, create the component and set it as root:
   ```cpp
   MeshComp = CreateDefaultSubobject<UStaticMeshComponent>(TEXT("Mesh"));
   RootComponent = MeshComp;
   ```
4. Override `BeginPlay` and add a log message:
   ```cpp
   UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("MyFirstActor spawned!"));
   ```
5. Compile (Ctrl+Alt+F11). Drag the new actor into the level, assign a static mesh in the Details panel, and press Play. Check the Output Log for the message.

**Expect:** An actor that appears in the world and logs a message on start.
hints: Make sure to `#include "Components/StaticMeshComponent.h"` at the top of the header.
If the log message doesn't appear, ensure you attached Visual Studio to the editor or look in the Output Log window.
expectedOutput: Actor visible with mesh, log message in Output Log.
